scope: 54 top-level Python implementation modules; literal tool references only, not an exhaustive dynamically resolved tool surface

modules.summary: Designator helpers. The architect list returns `id` (not `designatorId`), and
modules.assessment: Resolve Architect labels once, reject ambiguity, distinguish dropdown/child, keep width/height explicit. Use live definitions, not aliases as substitutions.

modules.summary: Alerts with the CULPRIT attached -- who, not just what.
modules.assessment: Compact culprit IDs and priority ranking. Keep target truncation visible; do not extract pawn identities from prose.

modules.summary: Worktable bills: what is queued, whether it can actually run, and the writes.
modules.assessment: Format recipes, ingredient shortfalls and bill configuration over our existing home/bills. No second execution engine.

modules.summary: Place a building with a ROTATION, and see which face lands where -- first.
modules.assessment: Copied reason/outcome/verdict formatting. Still useful: rotation/vent-side reports, material shortfalls and bounded suggestions.

modules.summary: What the colony has BUILT, what it is still building, and what is stuck.
modules.assessment: Pending work, materials, power-net topology and inspect-string summaries. Direct native reads exist; UI gizmo execution needs separate review.

modules.summary: The camera: who owns it, where home is, and how it gets back there.
modules.assessment: Home framing, camera bounds and human override. Remove fixed machine paths, leases tied to Hands and decorative zoom glides.

modules.summary: Who owns the camera right now: a Hands lease, and a queue of notices back.
modules.assessment: Use a single local camera owner with human override, not a multi-agent camera mailbox.

modules.summary: Cell -> screen pixel, so real mouse input can address the map.
modules.assessment: Assumes a particular fullscreen geometry and OS input path. Prefer native semantic targets.

modules.summary: Relay screened stream chat into the durable native-agent event bus.
modules.assessment: Audience moderation relay is not local player chat. Preserve untrusted-source tagging if streaming is added.

modules.summary: Real mouse clicks on the RimWorld window, for the two places the bridge can't
modules.assessment: Windows pixel input for exceptional setup screens; not a general gameplay API.

modules.summary: Is the game clock actually running? The question every VERIFIED line rests on.
modules.assessment: Reuse paused/running/unknown distinction. Strip supervisor-on-disk inference and turnclock remedy strings; flags alone do not prove job completion.

modules.summary: Safe combat-session ledger. Stage 1 never advances game time.
modules.assessment: Write-ahead draft ownership, verified native orders, guarded advancement and cleanup. Remove blanket map-hostile cleanup gate, turn ownership and extra services.

modules.summary: Verified combat UI actions shared by the future combat controller.
modules.assessment: Equipment tickets separate issuing a job from actual equipment. Prefer current home/order over older context-menu movement paths.

modules.summary: A quiet, combat-scoped camera director.
modules.assessment: Frame participants while time advances; relinquish on external pan/zoom. Keep camera changes outside model critical path.

modules.summary: RARE and SLOW: one question to Sol, minutes long. Launch it as a background task.
modules.assessment: External Codex consultant/model escalation conflicts with the chosen local single-model direction.

modules.summary: Type into the dialog that is on screen -- the only way to answer a text box.
modules.assessment: Native dialog-field enumeration and ambiguity rejection; requires DialogTextTool. Audit reflection setters per dialog before broad exposure.

modules.summary: Durable event delivery to Hands, falling back to Core only at handoff.
modules.assessment: SQLite durable outbox, acknowledgement and retries. Replace Core/Hands routing with our controller inbox.

modules.summary: Persist a loaded-game generation; discard observations from other timelines.
modules.assessment: Generation-stamped observations and rewind invalidation. Our saved colony ID plus per-load token supports memory beyond a loaded-session generation.

modules.summary: What one pawn wears, wields and carries -- and dropping one piece of it.
modules.assessment: Compact inventory/equipment. Do not copy instantaneous apparel drop: upstream explicitly bypasses the ordinary pawn job.

modules.summary: The formatter behind `pawns.py --health`: health records into lines.
modules.assessment: Pure health/needs formatters and sort keys over native pawn records; preserve unavailable values.

modules.summary: Relay overlay human messages into the durable native-agent event bus.
modules.assessment: Reliable player-message delivery through tool boundaries. Existing chat revision checks cover part of this; durable acknowledgement remains useful.

modules.summary: What the colony HAS, and where. A census, not a tile-by-tile search.
modules.assessment: Ownership, holders and loose/stockpiled partitions are useful. Replace vanilla nutrition tables with native def stats before food forecasting.

modules.summary: The letter stack: read it, open it, DECIDE it.
modules.assessment: Read choice-bearing letters, select native options, acknowledge/dismiss appropriately. Remove viewer holds and automatic stale-letter policy.

modules.summary: One Lookout pass: two screenshots, downscaled, handed to Luna with no context.
modules.assessment: Near/wide visual observations with game-evidence verification. Use the loaded local VL model; no mandatory external reviewer or fixed 180-second schedule.

modules.summary: Luna: the net under errata's turn summary. Condenses it to fit the card.
modules.assessment: Extra model call to compress a fixed overlay box. Our resizable dashboard and concise output can avoid this cost.

modules.summary: Seven layers of the same rectangle, because one character per tile is a lie.
modules.assessment: Layered compact map, sparse/rectangular queries, terrain/roof/storage/rooms/designations. Requires CellsPlus. This is a representation, not a base-layout solver.

modules.summary: Temporary packed-furniture helper; existing building tools are untouched.
modules.assessment: Packed furniture validation and two-stage item/destination targeting. Prefer a native install action over pixel placement when available.

modules.summary: Order a colonist to a cell, auto-drafting when needed.
modules.assessment: Older select/right-click/draft path with camera/modal dependencies; current home/order goto is the preferred route.

modules.summary: One pawn, one target, one order. Select and right-click, as a command.
modules.assessment: Native job refusal formatting, exact selector resolution, force/menu fallback discovery. home/order already compiled; no need to copy CLI parsing.

modules.summary: Fire-and-forget POSTs to the stream overlay. The stream never touches the game.
modules.assessment: Non-blocking presentation and bounded delivery diagnostics. Keep one same-origin dashboard, not a second overlay server.

modules.summary: Who is on the map, how they are, what they carry, and how they are set up.
modules.assessment: Work, schedule, animals, social relations, health and roster projections over existing native payloads. Drop unsupported instant gear mutations.

modules.summary: One map click, with the camera where the click needs to be, read back.
modules.assessment: Selection verification and camera visibility are essential when forced to click. Do not involve selection for direct native queries.

modules.summary: Durable supervised game control.
modules.assessment: Durable game-time ownership and event stops; distinct from turn clocks. Bind to our process rather than a Core/Hands session.

modules.summary: Background lease owner for ``home/supervised_play``.
modules.assessment: Companion lease heartbeat and event cursor. Merge into our async runtime instead of launching another Python service.

modules.summary: M's phone -> the running playthrough. One command, no JSON to compose.
modules.assessment: Player message plus explicit pause/interrupt. Existing local chat already supplies the message path.

modules.summary: What the colony is researching, what it could research, and why it isn't.
modules.assessment: Current research, benches, prerequisites and unlocks, plus normal selection. Requires ResearchTool; do not invent an equivalent Python simulation.

modules.summary: Direct client for the RimWorld bridge, for agents that aren't Codex.
tools: rimworld/set_draft: 'pawn' conflicts with explicit 'pawnName'/'pawnId'; pass exactly one pawn selector
modules.assessment: We already use the MCP SDK over stdio. Do not add a second hand-written HTTP transport or legacy argument shims.
not_exposed_tools: rimworld/set_draft: 'pawn' conflicts with explicit 'pawnName'/'pawnId'; pass exactly one pawn selector

modules.summary: Manual data-scout helpers and legacy report inspection.
modules.assessment: Legacy scout/brief formatters may help; seeded multi-agent scheduling and report mailboxes are not needed.

modules.summary: Detached singleton scheduler for the blind external screenshot reviewer.
modules.assessment: Fixed wall-clock external vision reviewer daemon is unnecessary for our current runtime.

modules.summary: Run a short guarded review slice and pause when it ends or something happens.
modules.assessment: Useful native event waiter, but old client pulse loop includes turn limits and any-hostile stops. Rebuild thinly around reviewed companion event semantics.

modules.summary: Identify the controlling process, including its birth time (PID reuse safe).
modules.assessment: PID plus process birth time prevents stale owner/PID reuse. Use in launch/session ownership checks, not Claude agent identity.

modules.summary: Claude lifecycle adapter: route native hook wakeups to their originating agent.
modules.assessment: Claude lifecycle hooks and cross-agent delivery are platform-specific.

modules.summary: Narrate one line to the stream. The fallback for everything without a flag.
modules.assessment: One concise outcome per intent; no mandatory character cap, first-person persona or mood service.

modules.summary: Centre the camera and capture an image for Hands to open themselves.
modules.assessment: Actual image input plus framing, not a path string. Remove per-turn screenshot quota.

modules.summary: Bring the whole RimWorld agent stack up with one command, and say so in 14 lines.
modules.assessment: Health/readiness, save validation and explicit ownership recovery. Keep our profile/launcher and avoid hardcoded colony save prefixes.

modules.summary: The whole between-turns read in one call: clock, letters, messages, alerts,
modules.assessment: Compact native status and meaningful deltas. Do not copy prose-derived global stopping policy.

modules.summary: The Core's end of the stream. Turn counter, handoffs, and M's channel.
modules.assessment: Goals/chat presentation is useful and partly adopted; Hands lifecycle, turn counters and service start orchestration are out.

modules.summary: Trade without the trade screen.
modules.assessment: Native TradeSession lifecycle, signed quantities, preview and accept. Keep adjacency for map traders; verify stock, price and receipt changes.

modules.summary: The turn clock: how long the fork holding the game has been holding it.
modules.assessment: User rejected per-agent elapsed-turn budgets; unrelated to actual game-time control.

modules.summary: Click UI by visible text -- and READ a surface without the geometry.
modules.assessment: Structured text/surface IDs, main-tab cleanup and selection readback. UI reads that open tabs are mutations and need serialized ownership.

modules.summary: The Lookout's second look, for when it is about to raise an alarm.
tools: rimworld/list_alerts did not answer, so nothing checked for fire
modules.assessment: Validate visual claims with native evidence. Regex topic gates and absence-of-fire-alert => no fire are not general proof.
not_exposed_tools: rimworld/list_alerts did not answer, so nothing checked for fire

modules.summary: Play in bounded steps and report what changed.
modules.assessment: Older broad polling loop overlaps native event waits. Do not copy range/hardcoded policy or automatic letter handling wholesale.

modules.summary: The world map, read without opening it.
modules.assessment: Biome/growing-season/settlement context directly from native world state; requires WorldTool.

modules.summary: Zones and storage, from the game's own zone manager -- one call, whole map.
modules.assessment: Zone/filter/crop/occupancy summaries and anomaly visibility. Core native zone tools already present; repair is an explicit mutation.
